title: Departure Range Buffer Below Plan
app: Tesla Fleet API / TeslaMate, Rivian telemetry, ChargePoint session exports, PlugShare trip logs, Smartcar, and OBD-II / home-charger data via APIs, CSV exports, MQTT, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=smartcar:vehicle
| stats latest(est_range_mi) as est_range_mi, latest(planned_trip_mi) as planned_trip_mi by vin departure_id
| eval range_buffer=round(est_range_mi-planned_trip_mi,0)
| where range_buffer<20
| sort range_buffer
description: Uses Smartcar departure planning exports telemetry to monitor range buffer between estimated range and the planned trip length in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for days when departure planning ran too close to empty, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Smartcar departure planning exports data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Departure table of planned miles versus range buffer.
grandmaExplanation: It produces range buffer between estimated range and the planned trip length so you can spot days when departure planning ran too close to empty before it becomes annoying.
